claims: The pinned overlay-1 listing contains a static conditional lit path that forms a dot product from qword +1 XYZ and vf08.xyz, clamps it to nonnegative, scales vf07.xyz, adds vf08.xyz, multiplies vf05.xyz, converts with FTOI0, and stores the result to output qword +1.

All 45 repeated-UV source-header candidate groups in the bounded interval have byte-identical four-byte planes, permitting 5,908 source-byte / packed-RGB vertex pairs across 105 exact-UV-matched tags.

On those 5,908 diagnostic pairs, a global per-channel affine fit of signed8 source XYZ to packet RGB has R² about 0.862, 0.863, and 0.861 for R/G/B, exceeding the unsigned8 lane control R² about 0.105, 0.105, and 0.106.
The measurements prove that overlay-1 executed this lit branch to generate all 5,915 packet RGB lanes in the captured COBRA interval.
